name: Senoo Tasuku
source: A second-year at Saisei Academy and a member of the idol unit Galaxy Standard. Speaks in Kyoto dialect. The only person he trusts is [url=/c37437]Reiji[/url], not to mention Tasuku has a bit of an arrogant personality. He is very good at both Stride and dancing.
